QuestInfo.name: Arcon's Blood?
QuestInfo.1: I found #p502# in #m10004000#, and as expected, he was unwilling to give me any #b#t4031010##k for free. He told me to go to the underground tunnel in the middle of the island, defeat #r75 #o21#s#k, and gather up #b40 #t4000020##k. I practically shivered from #p502#'s icy demeanor... In that moment, I almost regretted agreeing to help #p207#, but no one else had seemed willing to...
QuestInfo.2: #p502# asked me to defeat #o21#s and gather #t4000020# in return for #t4031010#.

0.0: So you want to acquire #b#t4031010##k? Hah, that's not a task for a nobody like you. You can't obtain #t4031010# unless you're strong... If you really want it, prove me wrong and show me that you are worthy...
0.1: There's an underground tunnel in the middle of this island... and in the deepest part live the mutants of Arcon. #rTake down 75 #o21#s#k in the cave and collect #b40 #t4000020##k. Do you think you can handle it?
0.2: That's right... The #b#t4000020##k looks like this #i4000020#. Get that into your naïve little head.

1.0: Hmmm... I may have underestimated you. All right, a promise is a promise. Here's the #t4031010#. Take it.

yes.0: This bottle contains the blood of an Arcon I slew... Hopefully you'll use it wisely, because it's a rare, precious item...

item.0: If you want the #t4031010# from me, go to the underground tunnel, #rdefeat 75 #o21#s#k, and bring me #b40 #t4000020##k. If you don't do at least that, I cannot possibly hand over the #t4031010# to a rookie like you.
